incidents.name: xLOOT staking redeem counts the same NFT id repeatedly
incidents.notes: Staking.redeem(uint256[]) totals the reward for every supplied token id, checking only ownerOf(id), before it advances nextRedeem[id], so seven owned xLOOT ids repeated 155 times each collected the freshly opened epoch reward 1,085 times.

sources.ref: onchain review: staking proxy 0x9d87Ff196646A99BDdb16876066aA863900118b4 created 2023-12-21T11:59:11Z by 0x50de00357b4c96defe9780bc285dc939bbb5ea2e, not the attack-tx sender 0xacdcd2e9787e889305200900d6cf6c0548578630; a single EIP-1967 Upgraded event at deployment installs implementation 0xf3A3648bB1Da9D3aeA107da77E6f5bA9Cf313127 (the address the PoC header names as the vulnerable contract), so the executing code was 846.1 days old. 6.21 ETH x $2,340.58 at the incident timestamp (DefiLlama) = $14,535.
